scripts.build: npm run build -w extension && npm run build -w signer
scripts.test: npm run test -w extension && npm run test -w signer && python3 -m pytest tests/test_contract_invariants.py -q
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w extension && npm run typecheck -w signer
scripts.verify: npm run lint:contract && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:direct && npm run build
scripts.zip: npm run build -w extension && python scripts/make-extension-zip.py
scripts.lint:contract: node scripts/run-genvm-lint.mjs lint contracts/margin.py && node scripts/run-genvm-lint.mjs lint contracts/margin_consumer.py
